title: Hakkunde Leydi e Asamaan
intro: Ruuhu sirlu ina fadi on e nder kelle ceniije daartol diine, ina njogii maandeeji e kaawniiɗe ɗe haa jooni ina njiyloo e nder yontaaji. No a tokkirta laawol limngal, a ɗon yaha nder taariiha kaawisaaji — diga fuɗɗam kaayeefi haa e yahdu dow asamaan. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo maccuɗo barkinaaɗo hade ƴoƴre sakkitiinde?
clues: Mi neldaama no nelaaɗo feewde e Ɓiɓɓe Israa’iila e kabaruuji yurmeende e annoore.
Jibineede am ko maande kaawis — mi arii e aduna mo mi alaa baaba, e yamiroore Joomiraacfo.
Mi haali ko mi cukalel, miɗo daranii teddungal yumma am e tuumeede leñol mum.
E yamiroore Alla, mi mbayli colli e loope, mi foofi nguurndam e nder majji — ɗi njippii e gite ƴeewooɓe.
Mi sellini wumɓe jibinɓe, mi sellinii ñawɗo, haa mi umminii maayɓe — kono kala kaawis ko e yamiroore Alla, wonaa e am.
Nde añɓe am pelliti halkude mi, Alla ɓamti kam dow asamaanuuji, fodani mi gartugol am ko adii ñalawma darnga.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
